content_feed.telegram_post: 📊 #RESULT | Mangalam Global Enterprise Limited (NSE: MGEL) Q2 FY27 Standalone & Consolidated Financial Results ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Consolidated Revenue from Operations: ₹982.56 Cr (up 39.21% YoY) - Consolidated Profit Before Tax (PBT): ₹12.27 Cr (up 41.85% YoY) - Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA: ₹23.10 Cr (up 38.57% YoY) - Standalone Revenue from Operations: ₹87,451.14 Lakhs 📌 What happened: ↳ Mangalam Global Enterprise Limited announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, reporting consolidated revenue of ₹982.56 crore and a Profit Before Tax of ₹12.27 crore. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing

content_feed.headline: Bansal Wire Industries Completes Stock Split from Rs. 5 to Rs. 1 Face Value
content_feed.worthiness_reason: Execution of stock split with credit confirmation of sub-divided shares and new ISIN activation.
content_feed.telegram_post: ✂️ #STOCK_SPLIT | Bansal Wire Industries Limited (NSE: BANSALWIRE) Bansal Wire Industries Completes Stock Split from Rs. 5 to Rs. 1 Face Value ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Split Ratio: 1:5 - Old Face Value: Rs. 5 per share - New Face Value: Rs. 1 per share - New ISIN: INE0B9K01033 📌 What happened: ↳ The company has completed the sub-division of its equity shares, with split shares successfully credited by NSDL and CDSL under a new ISIN. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing

content_feed.headline: Gabriel India Incorporates Joint Venture Company With Faurecia Automotive Seating
content_feed.worthiness_reason: Joint venture company incorporation and capital investment execution.
content_feed.telegram_post: 🤝 #JOINT_VENTURE | Gabriel India Limited (NSE: GABRIEL) Gabriel India Incorporates Joint Venture Company With Faurecia Automotive Seating ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - JV Company Name: Faurecia Anand Seating India Private Limited - Initial Investment: INR 20,00,00,000 - Gabriel India Stake: 50% less one equity share (INR 9,99,99,990) - FASI Stake: 50% plus one equity share (INR 10,00,00,010) 📌 What happened: ↳ Gabriel India Limited announced the incorporation of its joint venture company, Faurecia Anand Seating India Private Limited, alongside Faurecia Automotive Seating India Private Limited, following the initial joint venture agreement. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing

content_feed.headline: Kapston Services Approves Stock Split from Rs 5 to Rs 1 Face Value
content_feed.worthiness_reason: Company approved stock split from face value of Rs 5 to Rs 1 per share.
content_feed.telegram_post: ✂️ #STOCK_SPLIT | Kapston Services Limited (NSE: KAPSTON) Kapston Services Approves Stock Split from Rs 5 to Rs 1 Face Value ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Existing Face Value: Rs. 5 per share - New Face Value: Rs. 1 per share - Split Ratio: 5 new equity shares for 1 existing share - Approval Required: Shareholder approval via Postal Ballot 📌 What happened: ↳ The board approved subdividing each existing equity share into five shares, subject to shareholder approval through a postal ballot. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing
